copy.curiosityHook: Chan managed to bring down the crime boss virtually alone, but keeping his star witness safe long enough to reach the courtroom proves even more volatile.
copy.description: After single-handedly arresting a major drug lord following a chaotic chase through a hillside slum, Hong Kong police officer Chan Ka Kui is assigned to guard the kingpin's key witness, his secretary Selina.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and exciting with moderate crime stakes, balancing high-impact action and lighthearted comic energy.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Jackie Chan, this energetic blend of crime thriller, physical comedy, and kinetic stunt work delivers relentless momentum and suspenseful witness-protection stakes.

allowedMaterial: Officer Chan Ka Kui's solo arrest of the drug lord
The slum chase and shootout setup
The assignment to protect secretary Selina before she testifies in court
The blend of action, crime, and comedy tones
excludedMaterial: Climactic mall fight sequence and final resolution
